author: New China TV
description: Winter visitors have arrived in southwest China's Yunnan Province! More than 2,000 black-necked cranes have flown to the Dahaizi wetland in the Dashanbao Black-Necked Crane National Nature Reserve for the winter. Against the early winter landscape, the graceful birds can be seen strolling and foraging across the wetland, bringing it to life.
title: Black-necked cranes arrive in Yunnan for winter

title: Supermoon rises above Mount Tai

title: Xinhua News | New growth drivers fuel China's industrial profit gains

title: Xinhua News | PLA Army to display Z-20T, other advanced weaponry at Zhuhai airshow

author: New China TV
description: Meet Palaeophycus tiefengshanensis - Jurassic trace fossils from Tiefeng Mountain in Wanzhou, Chongqing. They have been identified as a new ichnospecies - the first of its kind found in Chongqing. #TraceFossils #Jurassic
title: A rare look at "traces of life" in the Early Jurassic

description: Sun's out, Zen mode on. These ring-tailed lemurs are soaking up the sunshine through the less dense fur on their bellies in a zoo in Zhengzhou, central China's Henan Province. #China #Lemurs #CuteAnimals #Sunbathing #Zhengzhou #Wildlife #Zen
title: Sun worshipping: Lemurs in Zen mode

author: New China TV
description:
"I'm not at all worried that AI will replace us," mathematician and Fields Medalist Shing-Tung Yau told Xinhua in Shenzhen, south China. His comments come as a proposed AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis by mathematician Levent Alpoge sparks debate over the future of mathematical discovery.
#ShingTungYau #AI #Mathematics #RiemannHypothesis #Science
title: Shing-Tung Yau: I'm not worried at all about AI replacing humans

author: New China TV
description: Qinhuangdao launched China's first "Snap-and-Report" supervision app, then the CCDI deployed the "One-Click Access to Supervision" platform to ensure that power is exercised under public oversight, in broad daylight, and in an institutional cage. In Lingzhuangzi Village, micro-power is fully transparent via QR codes -- sunlight is the best "antiseptic against corruption".
title: Unswervingly dedicated to the people: In broad daylight

author: New China TV
description: Imagine bumping into a "big cat" at work! A snow leopard strolled into a factory in Yumen, Gansu Province, before local authorities safely guided the healthy visitor back to the Qilian Mountains.
title: Surprise "big cat" at work! Snow leopard pays a visit to factory in NW China

author: New China TV
description:
The fall armyworm is a migratory pest that primarily feeds on maize. In late 2022, #China and the #FAO jointly launched a fall armyworm control project to teach farmers how to spot, monitor and track the pests. So far, 120 farmer field schools have been set up across Kenya and Ghana, directly reaching more than 5,000 farmers.
#Africa #SouthSouthCooperation
title: China, FAO join hands to combat fall armyworm in Africa

author: New China TV
description:
U.S. students on an exchange program got an up-close look at giant pandas at Hongshan Forest Zoo in Nanjing, East China. The modern urban zoo is recognized for replicating natural habitats through eco-friendly design while prioritizing animal welfare.
#GiantPanda #Nanjing #TrendyChina
title: Trendy China | U.S. students wowed by giant pandas at Nanjing zoo

AI-powered gadgets are moving straight from sci-fi to helping seniors live safely and independently.
Would you trust a robot to care for your parents? Drop your thoughts below! 
#TechTok #FutureTech #Robotics #ElderlyCare #ChinaTech #SmartHome #SilverEconomy #Innovation #Guangzhou

title: Christmas market lights up Tallinn's UNESCO-listed Old Town

title: Chinese supply chain empowers Kenya's electric motorcycle push

description:
A heavy load, a helping hand.
At a subway station in Nanning, China, an auxiliary police officer stepped in to help an older woman carry her homegrown bananas out of the station, reminding her to stay safe on her way home. #ActsOfKindness #HeartWarming #GoodSamaritan #Nanning #Subway
title: Chinese officer helps older woman carry homegrown bananas

description:

He also shared his insights into how AI could shape the future of mathematical research.
title: Mathematician Peter Sarnak wins inaugural Pan Prize in China

title: Forget square dancing! This village has "square kung fu"

description:

Watch how a gibbon teases these macaques at Sun River Forest Park in Pu'er, southwest China's Yunnan, and see who's the real master of the canopy.
#Gibbon #Macaque #Wildlife #Yunnan #China
title: Gibbon teases macaques in SW China forest

description: Imagine this on your way home. Yulong Snow Mountain towers above a sea of clouds in Lijiang, southwest China's Yunnan, its snow-capped peaks stretching as far as the eye can see. #JadeDragonSnowMountain #Lijiang #Yunnan #China #travel
title: Trendy China | When snow-capped peaks greet you on your way home

author: New China TV
description: Three high-speed railways opened in east China's Anhui Province on Friday, expanding the high-speed rail network in the Yangtze River Delta, one of China's most vibrant economic regions, to more than 8,500 km. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | High-speed rails in China's Yangtze River Delta top 8,500 km as three new lines open

author: New China TV
description:
Discover Bai tie-dye, a traditional craft of the Bai ethnic group in southwest China's #Yunnan Province. By tying, folding, and dyeing fabric, artisans create intricate patterns, often in striking shades of indigo and white.

Recognized as part of China's national intangible cultural heritage, the centuries-old craft offers visitors a hands-on opportunity to explore Bai culture and create their own unique pieces.
#TrendyChina
title: Trendy China | Discover the magic of Bai tie-dye in Yunnan

author: New China TV
description:
A breathtaking golden sunrise illuminated Yulong Snow Mountain in Lijiang, #Yunnan Province, southwest China.

The first rays of sunlight bathed its snow-capped peaks in a golden glow, creating a spectacular contrast between fire and ice.

Also known as Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, the mountain range boasts 13 majestic peaks, the highest soaring 5,596 meters above sea level. Its winding, snow-covered ridgeline resembles a dragon soaring through the clouds, hence its name.

#TrendyChina #AmazingChina
title: Trendy China | When snow turns to gold: sunrise over Yulong Snow Mountain

author: New China TV
description: Autumn has arrived at Qingshan Lake in Lin'an, Hangzhou, east China's Zhejiang Province. More than 10,000 pond cypress and bald cypress trees are turning shades of golden yellow and reddish brown, creating a stunning floating forest against a lake covered in lush green duckweed. With boats gliding between the trees and colorful foliage reflected in the water, this enchanting landscape offers a perfect escape into the beauty of autumn.
title: Autumn colors transform the floating forest of Qingshan Lake in Hangzhou
